title: Basilisk House Trap
summary: The trap located in Basilisk House consisted of a large stone carving of King Basilisk, with its head blocked by a curtain. Pulling back the curtain and looking into the carving's eyes unleashed a purple energy that petrifies its victim. This trap was used to guard the resting place of King Basilisk.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext: This trap was disarmed by [[Lok Lambert]] by using a mirror to reflect the petrifying energy back on the trap, thus destroying it. Doing so revealed a secret room behind the carving containing a statue of [[King Basilisk]] with its [[Amulet]] resting inside. {{source|Absent Heroes}}

The '''trap''' located in [[Basilisk House]] consisted of a large stone carving of [[King Basilisk]], with its head blocked by a curtain. Pulling back the curtain and looking into the carving's eyes unleashed a purple energy that petrifies its victim. This trap was used to guard the resting place of King Basilisk.

==History==
This trap was disarmed by [[Lok Lambert]] by using a mirror to reflect the petrifying energy back on the trap, thus destroying it. Doing so revealed a secret room behind the carving containing a statue of [[King Basilisk]] with its [[Amulet]] resting inside. {{source|Absent Heroes}}
